preconditions.description: The number of breakfasts b must be a non-negative integer up to 10^18.
The number of dinners d must be a non-negative integer up to 10^18.
The number of suppers s must be a non-negative integer up to 10^18.
The sum of breakfasts, dinners, and suppers must be at least 1.

postconditions.description: The output must be the minimum number of meals missed, calculated as the total meals minus 2, ensuring it does not go below zero.

raw_response: {"interface":{"mode":"stdin_stdout","signature":"stdin -> stdout"},"preconditions":[{"id":"P1","expression":"0 <= b <= 10**18","description":"The number of breakfasts b must be a non-negative integer up to 10^18."},{"id":"P2","expression":"0 <= d <= 10**18","description":"The number of dinners d must be a non-negative integer up to 10^18."},{"id":"P3","expression":"0 <= s <= 10**18","description":"The number of suppers s must be a non-negative integer up to 10^18."},{"id":"P4","expression":"b + d + s >= 1","description":"The sum of breakfasts, dinners, and suppers must be at least 1."}],"postconditions":[{"id":"Q1","expression":"stdout == str(max(0, b + d + s - 2))","description":"The output must be the minimum number of meals missed, calculated as the total meals minus 2, ensuring it does not go below zero."}],"invariants":[]}
